silk_animated_backgrounds.description: CSS-only liquid silk lighting for dead pure-black sections. Low-opacity gold/champagne ambient glows over ink background.

variants.name: Corner Ambient Glow
variants.usage: Visagismo section background, section headers, subtle side accents
variants.css_recipe: bg-ink relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:-top-40 before:-right-40 before:w-[500px] before:h-[500px] before:rounded-full before:bg-[radial-gradient(circle,rgba(201,169,97,0.08)_0%,rgba(228,207,155,0.03)_45%,transparent_70%)] before:animate-silk-pulse pointer-events-none
variants.keyframes: @keyframes silkPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1) translate(0, 0); opacity: 0.7; } 50% { transform: scale(1.15) translate(-20px, 20px); opacity: 1; } }

variants.name: Centered Silk-Wave Sweep
variants.usage: Elegance Membership section hero container background
variants.css_recipe: bg-ink relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_50%_30%,rgba(228,207,155,0.07)_0%,rgba(201,169,97,0.02)_50%,transparent_80%)] after:absolute after:top-0 after:left-[-100%] after:w-[200%] after:h-full after:bg-[linear-gradient(115deg,transparent_40%,rgba(201,169,97,0.04)_50%,transparent_60%)] after:animate-silk-sweep pointer-events-none
variants.keyframes: @keyframes silkSweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-30%); } 50% { transform: translateX(15%); } 100% { transform: translateX(-30%); } }

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, cards, tabs) MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT rebuild from scratch. Preserve existing structure in App.js and components.
Ensure all new CSS animation keyframes for liquid silk are added to App.css or index.css.
Add data-testid to every interactive component.
Ensure responsive layout on mobile screens (360px, 390px, 414px) without horizontal scroll.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion and CSS keyframe animations.
